name: WLF_GEN_AI_RESOURCES
description: This table stores the details of the resources used to generate summary using Gen AI.

columns.name: GEN_AI_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the identifier of the resource object.

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: Specifies the product family associated with the resource.

columns.name: INPUT_SOURCE
columns.description: Specifies the input source for the object (e.g., Business Object, Email Account, etc.,)

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the resource object type (e.g., Learning Item, Job Profile, etc.,)

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAILS
columns.description: Specifies the details of the source object.

columns.name: LATEST_PROCESSING_STATUS
columns.description: Specifies the latest object processing status.

columns.name: LATEST_RAG_PUBLISH_DATE
columns.description: Specifies the timestamp when the object summary is published to RAG.

columns.name: GEN_AI_USE_CASE_ID
columns.description: Specifies the use case used to generate summary using Gen AI.

columns.name: GEN_AI_PROMPT
columns.description: Specifies the prompt used to generate summary using Gen AI.

columns.name: GEN_AI_SUMMARY
columns.description: Specifies the summary generated by Gen AI.

columns.name: SLDS_OBJECT
columns.description: Represents SLDS object for a given Gen AI resource

columns.name: OBJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: Represents synthetic Object logical key

columns.name: CURATED_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies if the sythetic object data is curated or not

columns.name: ESS_JOB_ID
columns.description: Specifies the enterprise scheduler job id that processed the resource.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
